headline: Statistics-aware software for omics, spatial and network inference across modalities
label: Computational Tools For Omics Analysis
summary: Growing multi-omic and single-cell datasets require inference tools that validate statistical assumptions and integrate heterogeneous modalities.
synthesis: The common thread is software that makes statistical treatment explicit within omics workflows. MorphoStat and StickForStats add assumption handling, normalizing plate effects in morphological profiling and rerouting assumption violations to nonparametric tests. gamdid and the Bayesian variational framework extend differential analysis to single-cell data, with gamdid testing distributional shape beyond mean shifts and the latter modeling patient-level dependence across millions of cells. Other entries target integration: sbivar tests spatial association between modalities with disjoint coordinates, MPOInt combines total, phospho, and histone proteomics with epigenetic effectors, and FICUS links transcriptomic context to Boolean and logic-ODE models of patient subgroups. OmniPath Metabo and Drug-Prot provide metabolome and proteome resources and query frameworks, while MOREshiny exposes multi-omic regulatory network inference through a no-code interface. The shared emphasis is statistical correctness and interoperability rather than a single method.
